notes.title: Minor Patch - Screen Resolution Sizes
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,



Hope you're enjoying the Demo, and if you have an advanced copy of the full release, then I hope you're enjoying that too!



Just a quick bug fix:

fixed a bug with various screen sizes, particularly 16:10 aspect ratios. The game has been designed for 1920x1080p (16:9), but also works well for any other resolution. Please let me know if this is still an issue for your resolution/monitor!

notes.title: Release Date Annoucement and Inclusion in Indie Game Festivals on now!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We've been hard at work on the Full Release of the Game and we are ecstatic to announce that the release date will be 26th September!

We've made a whole range of changes to the game to make each run feel different and push the player to come up with strategies to exploit what's made available in any particular run.

See the Release Date Announcement Trailer on the Steam page or at: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/bTKk6K2UXSU"][/dynamiclink]

We are also excited to be included in the following awesome Festivals on Steam!

notes.title: Update on Release Date
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504067/e61c95e69cd78221a25cbc57466ea994819c4c7a.png"]

Hello everyone!

We have decided to delay the release of the game until September (instead of the planned date of 25th July) to ensure the game has been thoroughly tested.

It's been a rough combo of sickness, testing taking longer than expected, and having other commitments take priority recently.

But enough with the excuses... This Update's update on differences between the Demo and Full Release are: 
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="135,151,"][tr][th colwidth="135"]

[/th][th colwidth="151"]
Demo
[/th][th]
Full Release
[/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"]
Crest resources
[/td][td colwidth="151"]
Not available
[/td][td]
Each King has a corresponding Crest resource, which when used quickens the pace of the game by increasing favour gain and immediately ending Grace Period.
[/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"]
Ascension Powder resource
[/td][td colwidth="151"]
Adds one of two unique effects to a random card in hand when used.
[/td][td]
Passively gives +1 upgrade whenever a Card is upgraded (e.g. accelerating a card in the Vault, or using the Temper Hand unique effect). This keeps upgrading Cards in this way relevant into the late game. Ascension powder can be used if a particular Perk is unlocked and active, where it greatly buffs a number of Cards equal to the amount of Ascension powder used.
[/td][/tr][/table]


Thanks again for playing :)
